layout.name: Side by side bar chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>

chart {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border8";
	header : "@#label5";
	labels[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bar1.label") #>";
	labels[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bar2.label") #>";
	labels[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bar3.label") #>";
	labels[3] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bar4.label") #>";
	labels[4] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bar5.label") #>";
	labels[5] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bar6.label") #>";
	legendPosition : "Absolute";
	legendVisible : "true";
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "578,325";
	projectorReversed : "false";
	renderingType : "BAR";
	sampleSeries[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.dataSet1.text") #>,100,125,245.78,147,67,67:BAR";
	sampleSeries[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.dataSet2.text") #>,10,100,300,10,100,50:BAR";
	type : "CARTESIAN";
	XGridVisible : "false";
	YGridVisible : "true";
}

chartGrid {
	fill : "true";
	majorPaint : "#FFedf2f6";
	majorStroke : "@=stroke4";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	border : "@#border7";
	followChartResize : "true";
	font : "SansSerif,10";
	foreground : "dimgray";
	location : "75,35";
	paintingBackground : "false";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] {
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	title : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.bottomAxis.title") #>";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
	titleRotation : "-0.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] {
	autoDataRange : "true";
	foreground : "#FF4580b4";
	labelColor : "#FF4580b4";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	title : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.leftAxis.title") #>";
	titleColor : "#FF4580b4";
	titleRotation : "-90.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
}



series[index="0"] {
	color1 : "#FFfeedcb";
	renderingType : "CLUSTERED_BAR";
}

series[index="1"] {
	color1 : "#FFc4def4";
	renderingType : "CLUSTERED_BAR";
}

Subobject#border3 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#border6 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#border7 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border8 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#label2 {
	border : "@#border3";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-16";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label5 {
	border : "@#border6";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-16";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SideBySideBar.header") #>";
}

Subobject#stroke4 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}
